title: Genuine courier call: delivery address
label: genuine
notes: Hard negative: mentions a parcel and a payment (cash on delivery).

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello sir, Delhivery se bol raha hoon, aapka parcel aaya hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Address mein flat number nahi likha hai, thoda location bata dijiye.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Theek hai, cash on delivery hai, ₹899 ready rakhiye ya UPI se de dijiye.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Main 20 minute mein pahunch jaunga. Thank you sir.
